text: SAIC Motor's controlling shareholder is Shanghai Automotive Industry (Group) Co., Ltd., which holds 63.71% of the shares and is a state-owned enterprise supervised by the Shanghai Municipal State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (Shanghai SASAC).

source.name: SAIC Motor Corporation Limited — Annual Report 2025 (English), shareholders and related-party notes
source.quote: The Company’s parent company is SAIC (Group), which is a state owned enterprise supervised by Shanghai SASAC
source.note: SAIC Motor Annual Report 2025 (published April 2026). The same report's top-shareholder table lists Shanghai Automotive Industry (Group) Co., Ltd. with 7,324,009,279 shares (63.71%) as a 'State-owned legal person', and its definitions give 'Shanghai SASAC: Refers to Shanghai State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission'.

additionalSources.name: SAIC Motor Corporation Limited — 2026 semi-annual report (cninfo filing, Chinese)
additionalSources.quote: 本公司的母公司为上汽总公司，上汽总公司系上海市国有资产监督管理委员会出资监管的国 有企业。
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'The Company's parent company is SAIC (Group) (Shanghai Automotive Industry (Group) Co., Ltd.), which is a state-owned enterprise funded and supervised by the Shanghai Municipal State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission.' The same filing's top-shareholder table lists 上海汽车工业（集团）有限公司 with 7,324,009,279 shares, 63.71%, 国有法人 (state-owned legal person).
